reference.source: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine / WHO
clinicalPearls: Bartonella species cause a spectrum of illness; Bartonella henselae is the usual agent of cat scratch disease, typically following a scratch or bite from a young cat or flea exposure
Cat scratch disease classically presents with a papule or pustule at the inoculation site followed by regional lymphadenopathy that is often tender and can suppurate
Most immunocompetent patients have a self-limiting illness, and management is often supportive with antibiotics reserved for more severe or systemic disease
In immunocompromised patients, particularly those with advanced HIV, Bartonella can cause bacillary angiomatosis with vascular proliferative skin and visceral lesions
Bartonella is an important cause of culture-negative endocarditis, so it should be considered when blood cultures remain sterile
Atypical presentations include prolonged fever of unknown origin, hepatosplenic granulomatous disease, neuroretinitis with a macular star, and encephalopathy
Diagnosis relies on serology, PCR, or special stains and histology, as the organism is fastidious and difficult to culture by routine methods
reference.pathophysiology: Bartonella are fastidious, facultatively intracellular Gram-negative bacteria that infect erythrocytes and endothelial cells. Transmission occurs through animal scratches or bites and arthropod vectors such as fleas and lice depending on species. In immunocompetent hosts the infection typically provokes a granulomatous immune response producing localised lymphadenitis. The bacterium's ability to invade endothelium and stimulate vascular proliferation underlies bacillary angiomatosis and peliosis seen in immunocompromised patients, and its persistence within red cells and on cardiac valves accounts for bacteraemia and endocarditis.
additionalDifferentials: Lymphoma and other causes of regional lymphadenopathy
Other causes of culture-negative endocarditis (e.g. Coxiella)
Kaposi sarcoma (for the vascular lesions of bacillary angiomatosis)
additionalInvestigations: Bartonella serology (indirect immunofluorescence or EIA) as a first-line test
PCR of blood, lymph node aspirate, or tissue for Bartonella DNA
Histopathology of affected nodes or skin lesions, with special stains such as Warthin-Starry silver stain
Echocardiography and repeated cultures when endocarditis is suspected
HIV testing and immune status assessment when bacillary angiomatosis is considered
redFlags: Culture-negative endocarditis with embolic phenomena or heart failure
Neuroretinitis with visual loss, or encephalopathy and seizures
Disseminated vascular lesions (bacillary angiomatosis) in an immunocompromised patient
Persistent high fever, hepatosplenic lesions, or systemic deterioration
reference.prognosis: Cat scratch disease in immunocompetent people usually resolves spontaneously over weeks to months, while endocarditis, disseminated disease, and complications in immunocompromised hosts require prolonged antibiotic therapy and carry greater morbidity.
pitfalls: Overlooking Bartonella as a cause of culture-negative endocarditis
Failing to elicit a history of cat or flea exposure in regional lymphadenopathy
Not assessing immune status when vascular proliferative lesions are found
Draining or excising nodes unnecessarily in what is often a self-limiting illness
management: Supportive care alone for most immunocompetent cat scratch disease, which is self-limiting
Azithromycin, a macrolide, for significant or bulky lymphadenopathy
Needle aspiration of tender suppurative nodes for relief, avoiding incision and drainage which risks sinus formation
Prolonged combination antibiotic therapy for endocarditis, typically a tetracycline with an aminoglycoside or a ceftriaxone-based regimen, with valve surgery where indicated
Macrolide or tetracycline therapy for bacillary angiomatosis in immunocompromised hosts
HIV testing and antiretroviral optimisation when bacillary angiomatosis or disseminated disease is found
Advice on cat and flea exposure to reduce the risk of reinfection
